hypothesis: Unmapped fault pixels - the competition target class - are concentrated where an independent state geologic map already records structure and where detrended topography is steep; a fault-likeness classifier trained only on that independent map, blended with the topography percentile and sampled on a 300 m Poisson-disk lattice, places predictions on unmapped fault habitat rather than re-drawing the mapped catalogue.
mechanism: HistGradientBoosting (41 features: 19 organizer bands, 11 lidar scarp bands, 8 radiometric bands, distances) trained on USGS SGMC faults; prior = 0.6*model + 0.4*topography percentile; score-ordered Poisson-disk dots at 3 px minimum spacing, footprint only, catalogue excluded.
named_non_fault_mimic: Fluvial terrace risers, landslide headwalls, Lake Lahontan shorelines, road cuts and lithologic contacts produce the same topographic steps and would be false positives.

inputs_verified.note: Owner-mirror bytes, hash-pinned to the values recorded by the GEMSDOE31 data manifest; not an authenticated organizer download.

primary_evidence.evidence_class: SGMC-PROXY-DTI (independent USGS state-map faults >300 m from the public catalogue; NOT a leaderboard score)
primary_evidence.evaluator: src.gemsdoe.fastdti.fast_dti, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, R=3 px, catalogue masked
primary_evidence.ci_method: component-cluster bootstrap, 1000 reps, FP term held fixed (lower-bound width)
primary_evidence.model_oof: 4-quadrant spatial CV, pooled AUC 0.792; the DTI above is computed from out-of-fold predictions only.
primary_evidence.truth_px_note: 62,122 recomputed 2026-10-31 as SGMC & footprint & (distance-to-catalogue > 3.0 px). An earlier draft of the prior-experiment file recorded 61,664 using a slightly different catalogue-proximity edge convention; the DTI curve reproduces to 4 decimals on 62,122, so all published numbers use this value.

catalogue_holdout.result: 0.1037 at 150k dots for the 0.5*lidar-scarp + 0.5*topography blend vs 0.0902 random; the SGMC model term is not included in this holdout because its catalogue-distance feature uses the full catalogue.

in_sample_diagnostic.label: IN-SAMPLE, NOT EVIDENCE: the emitted raster is produced by a model trained on all SGMC positives; its agreement with SGMC is not out-of-sample.

uniqueness.rule: raw Spearman rank correlation and 3-px dot halo against every acquired registry raster
uniqueness.dense_raster_caveat: A locally stored blanket raster (wbg-h1-blind-conduit-breach, 5,167,373 positive cells = the entire footprint) trivially contains 100% of any dot set within 3 px. That one-directional comparison is vacuous and is reported as such; the repo documented this defect on 2026-10-28.

smoothed_spearman_all_grid.disposition: exceeds the 0.90 threshold; null baseline is 0.85, excess 0.056-0.067; protocol dot test passes 27.05%% vs 70%%. Full reasoning: evidence/wbg5_rule_decision.json and evidence/wbg5_smoothed_null.json

submission.name: wbg5-sgmc-topo-poisson150k-20261031-zeros
submission.note: SGMC-trained unmapped-fault prior + detrended topography; 150k dots at 300 m spacing, known faults masked

projection.label: NO ABSOLUTE SCORE IS PROJECTED
projection.ordering_claim: Under the assumption that the SGMC benchmark is representative of the hidden new-fault set, our surface should outrank GEMSDOE32 B2 at equal budget, and we ship 4x more dots than B2.
projection.why_no_number_here: The organizer masks all known USGS/INGENIOUS pixels and scores one pooled Tversky index over the whole GeoDAWN area. No local harness reproduces that mask, so any absolute conversion from SGMC-PROXY-DTI to an organizer score is unfalsifiable. An earlier draft carried a 0.20-0.35 band; it has been removed because its lower edge was below the observed 0.2778 and its basis was not reproducible.
projection.known_risk: If the hidden new-fault set is concentrated on a different geological signature than the SGMC off-catalogue faults (e.g. short splays rather than long structures), the equal-budget advantage may not transfer.

residual_risks: Hidden truth may be Quaternary-only and closer to the catalogue than SGMC; then the SGMC term is less transferable.
The public subset is unknown; only predictions inside it are scored.
A local format pass is not proof of portal acceptance; submit once and read the receipt.
The dense-raster one-directional overlap check is vacuous by construction.

audits: equal-budget control vs GEMSDOE32 B2 and GEMSDOE25 D2.8
budget.protocol_note: The three-experiment cap was respected for model/hypothesis experiments. Four verification audits were run afterwards because they test the harness, not a new hypothesis; they are counted here for full disclosure. Elapsed modelling time is within the 2 h cap.

equal_budget_control.why: The public champion files ship 37,654-44,090 dots; this submission ships 150,000. Comparing the shipped files directly would confound surface quality with budget.
equal_budget_control.method: Re-select our top 37,654 dots from the same out-of-fold blend surface and score both dot sets on the identical truth array and evaluator.
equal_budget_control.reading: At equal budget our surface beats the current-best public file by 1.64x on the independent SGMC benchmark. This is the defensible comparison; the 0.3234 vs 0.2778 headline comparison is not, because the two numbers come from different scoring modes.

blend_audit.note: The 0.7/0.3 blend is 0.9% higher than the shipped 0.6/0.4, inside the reported CI. It was not substituted because that would be post-hoc selection on an unresolvable difference.
